meta.title: Edificio Biera · 10 new-build triplex townhouses in Santa Catalina, Murcia
meta.description: Edificio Biera: 10 new-build triplex townhouses with private roof terrace and parking in Santa Catalina, Murcia. 3 and 4 bedrooms from 330.000 € + VAT. Information and viewings: JD León Inmobiliaria, 640 51 24 34.

hero.h1: More than a home, a way of life.
hero.sub: 3 and 4 bedrooms + study · private roof terrace · parking
hero.alt: Facade of Edificio Biera at sunset: ten triplex townhouses with Mediterranean lines, planters and warm light
proj.p1: Ten triplex townhouses on the Carretera de Santa Catalina. Light facades, clean lines and natural light across all three floors, up to the private roof terrace.
proj.p2: Inside, flooring and bathrooms by Porcelanosa Grupo and JUNG fittings.

fig2.t: bedrooms, plus a study in the attic room
fig3.t: of private roof terrace, depending on the home
fig4.t: private garages in the basement, with their own staircase
casa.h2: Three floors and a sky of your own.
casa.alt: Aerial view of the building showing the roofs and private roof terraces of each triplex
casa.l1.p: A private terrace of 18 to 77 m², depending on the home, next to a separate room each family can choose: office, study, bedroom or playroom. Sun in winter, dinners outdoors in summer.
casa.l2.p: Bedrooms and bathrooms, away from the pace of the day.
casa.l3.p: Living-dining room, kitchen and toilet, with natural light.
casa.l4.p: Private garage with its own staircase or parking space, depending on the home.

gal.alt1: Living-dining room and kitchen with large windows and wood-tone slatted flooring
gal.alt2: Bright living room with sofa, low sideboard and dining area in the background
gal.alt3: Aerial view of the corner of the building showing the roof terraces
gal.alt4: Bedroom with upholstered headboard, wooden bedside table and warm light
gal.quote: Sun in winter, dinners outdoors in summer.
gal.note: Illustrative renders, non-contractual. Furniture and decor not included; the kitchen is delivered unfurnished.
qual.p: Flooring and bathrooms by Porcelanosa Grupo, JUNG fittings and Guardian glass. Finishes are chosen, among the options provided, at the Porcelanosa showroom, on a visit arranged by JD León.
q1.s: Vinyl flooring by Porcelanosa Grupo in 22.8 × 180 cm planks. Natural, Nude or Beige tones.
q2.s: Thermostatic shower column and wall-hung unit.
q3.s: In alpine white. A classic of German design.
q4.s: Insulation against cold and heat, with aluminium shutters.
q6.s: Fully integrated, with no visible units.
q7.s: Interior doors lacquered in white, with concealed hinges.
q8.s: Pre-installation of fibre optic cabling and data points in the home.
loc.h2: Between the city and the mountains.
loc.p: On the Carretera de Santa Catalina, on the corner with C/ Los Mateos, south of Murcia. Next to the Ronda Sur, with quick access to the motorways. Opposite, a large sports centre that has recently opened.
loc.svg: Distances from Edificio Biera: 1.6 km to Hospital Mesa del Castillo, 3.5 km to Estación del Carmen and 4.8 km to Hospital Virgen de la Arrixaca
con.p: Daniel León explains each home, answers your questions and arranges your visit to the site and the Porcelanosa showroom.
